text:
maria: Quick postmortem from my onboarding session: the sample-tool blew up when I tried rotating a project-scoped key. Got consistent 401s even after exporting the new key.

tony: hmm which env var name did you use? we have a few historical names floating around.

maria: I followed the README which says `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=proj_live_abc123`. After rotation I set `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=proj_live_new456` and retried. Logs show: 
```
2025-01-11T14:03:12Z ERROR request /v1/embeddings 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"}
2025-01-11T14:03:12Z DEBUG resolver: used env var REDWOOD_TOKEN (masked)
```
I never set REDWOOD_TOKEN locally.

kbots: This looks like the classic resolver precedence mismatch. Some SDKs still read REDWOOD_TOKEN as the canonical env var; others prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. If there is a creds file under ~/.redwood/creds the SDK can cache that at startup and ignore later env changes.

infra-lee: we saw this in staging during org rotations: systemd drop-ins write the file then set envs, and services that don't re-evaluate envs continue using the old disk token.

maria: minimal reproduce I ran: 
```
# start fresh
mv ~/.redwood/creds ~/.redwood/creds.bak || true
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=proj_live_new456
node sample-tool/index.js
# then rotate by writing a creds file to disk and set REDWOOD_TOKEN
printf "token=proj_live_old789" > ~/.redwood/creds
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=proj_live_old789
# process still uses REDWOOD_TOKEN despite REDWOOD_API_KEY present
```

ton y: (typo) I mean: the bug is that when the creds file appears after process start, the resolver caches the disk token and treats it as higher priority than env even when REDWOOD_API_KEY exists. There are three problematic patterns: env-only, disk-only, and env+disk divergence.

docs-ana: We should stop teaching people multiple env var names in examples. It's been a footgun. Proposal: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY across SDKs and sampleapps, deprecate REDWOOD_TOKEN with a clear migration note.

kbots: Suggested short-term mitigations: 1) Add a runtime check: if both REDWOOD_TOKEN and REDWOOD_API_KEY exist and differ, emit a clear WARNING at startup showing masked values and which one will be used. 2) Make the resolver re-evaluate env on each request at low cost (check process.env key) to handle in-process rotations. 3) CLI should write creds and then send a SIGHUP or write a version file so processes can detect changes instead of racing on file writes.

maria: For onboarding docs: include a troubleshooting snippet: 
```
# troubleshooting key rotation
# 1) ensure only REDWOOD_API_KEY is set in env
unset REDWOOD_TOKEN
# 2) if you use the CLI, restart the process after rotation
pkill -HUP -f sample-tool || true
# 3) check for ~/.redwood/creds and remove stale entries
```

tony: Implementation plan: short term patch in node and python SDKs to prefer env var each request + warning banner when mismatched. Mid-term: deprecate alternate names and update sampleapps, quickstarts, and onboarding guides. Long-term: central credential resolver library consumed by all SDKs.

infra-lee: I'll add a KB runbook for Dedicated customers describing safe rotation: 1) rotate in secrets manager 2) update systemd env 3) restart workers (or use SIGHUP) 4) validate no 401s via smoke-test route.

docs-ana: I'll sweep all sampleapps and docs to use REDWOOD_API_KEY only. Also adding a short migration CS article: "Migrating from REDWOOD_TOKEN to REDWOOD_API_KEY" with CLI commands and examples.

kbots: Note: file an issue in redwood/sdk-cred with logs and repro and tag @eng-runtime. Also add CI integration test to sample-tool that simulates rotation (set env, start process, change env file, assert next request uses new key).

maria: filed issue #452 and pasted repro + logs. I'll open a tiny PR that adds the CI rotation test and the masked-warning log.

ton y: thanks. One more behavioral ask: when env var changes, don't just re-evaluate; clear any in-memory caches (KV) of the token to avoid stale usage.

infra-lee: agreed. We'll coordinate the patch rollout with a canary on staging to ensure no regressions.

docs-ana: ETA for docs sweep and migration guide: next Tuesday.

maria: resolved for now with workaround (unset REDWOOD_TOKEN + restart). happy to pair on tests tomorrow. :party_parrot:
